name: rootrecord-business-android
description: Android (Capacitor) wrapper for the Business Manager web app. Web source lives at Web/apps/business-manager-web.

scripts.cap:sync: pnpm run build:web && pnpm exec cap sync
scripts.android:apk: pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat clean assembleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/copy-android-artifacts.js apk
scripts.android:bundle:release: pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/copy-android-artifacts.js aab
scripts.android:apk-and-bundle: pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat clean assembleRelease bundleRelease && cd .. && node scripts/copy-android-artifacts.js all
